ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_weighted_softplus_advantage
ir.intuition: Repaired to avoid overuse of logsigmoid and reduce similarity by replacing logsigmoid with ops.softplus on the negative difference of log probabilities. This models margin as a smooth positive softplus activation of (log_prob_l - log_prob_w), scaling with advantage_gap and sample weight to emphasize stronger preferences. Negating softplus ensures a loss suitable for minimization. This stabilizes gradients and offers a distinct nonlinear transformation, improving novelty and expressiveness while maintaining necessary keys and pairwise mode.
ir.pseudocode:
adv = advantage_gap
margin = softplus(log_prob_l - log_prob_w) * adv
loss = mean(weight * (-margin))  # negative sign to minimize softplus of opposite difference
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)

    margin = ops.softplus(ops.sub(lpl, lpw))
    weighted_margin = ops.mul(margin, adv)
    loss = ops.neg(weighted_margin)
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
